name: hallmark-inspection-prototype
description: Terrain evidence for mobile robot supervision: Earth search and rescue and lunar rover exploration.

scripts.generate:earth: node tools/generate-earth-fixture.mjs langtang && node tools/generate-earth-fixture.mjs diepenbeek
scripts.render:earth-surface: python3 tools/render-earth-surface.py langtang && python3 tools/render-earth-surface.py diepenbeek
scripts.check:earth-surface: python3 tools/render-earth-surface.py langtang --check && python3 tools/render-earth-surface.py diepenbeek --check
scripts.fetch:earth: node tools/fetch-earth-source.mjs langtang --write && node tools/fetch-earth-source.mjs diepenbeek --write
scripts.fetch:basemap: node tools/fetch-basemap.mjs langtang --write && node tools/fetch-basemap.mjs diepenbeek --write
